title: Hollie M Probable NDE 4748
content: I was in a field and this place was the most beautiful, peaceful place I had ever been. There really wasn't anything spectacular about it. It was a field but there was a hill with one tree on it. This tree was beautiful with the leaves swaying. All I wanted to do was walk to the tree. There was no sound, yet I heard singing like I have never heard before. The closest sound came after I was finally home and saw a boy on TV they claimed he had the voice of an Angel and he really did, I cried! While in this place, I began walking toward this tree and my guardian Angel came to me. She spoke not with her mouth but clearly in my head. She said, 'You need to stop and wait.' I kept looking past her and moved around her to get to this tree. Her voice came more forcefully, 'Remember.' She held up her hand and on each one of her fingers there was a moving photo of my four children and she said remember them you have to wait. I can honestly say I didn't know them as my children at the time. I felt nothing toward them. The purpose I felt that I had was to get to the beautiful tree. I went to move around her again and she said look and pointed to the sky where clouds were making shapes like a bunny and she said rest here watch the clouds remember. I went to side step her again and it was like this powerful screaming from her, 'Wait! Rest here. You are needed!' I did as she asked. I lay down in the field to watch the clouds. The next thing I felt was this powerful force lifting me up. Then I was thrown down and I landed in the bottom of the bluest water. It was so far down; I was struggling to get to the top to breathe. When I woke up I was on a ventilator in the intensive care unit, but I felt like I was coming out of the water and trying to suck in a mouthful of air.

arrival.other_being_detail: Guardian angel described as 'she' who communicated in the experiencer's head and showed images of four children on her fingers.

environment.environment_other_detail: A peaceful field with a hill and a single tree with swaying leaves; no sound yet 'singing'; later 'bottom of the bluest water.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a powerful force lifting her up, then was thrown down and experienced being at the bottom of water; awoke on a ventilator feeling like coming out of the water and trying to breathe.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Angel said: 'You are needed!' and referenced her four children.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard singing with no sound; shown moving photos of children on angel's fingers; clouds forming shapes (e.g., bunny); later underwater imagery before waking on ventilator.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience begins already in a peaceful field (no OBE/tunnel described), then encounter with guardian angel and repeated instruction to wait, followed by forceful transition to underwater scene and awakening in ICU.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Angel held up her hand and each finger displayed a moving photo of the experiencer's four children; 'no sound, yet I heard singing'; clouds making shapes like a bunny; return felt like being lifted then thrown into deep blue water.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You need to stop and wait.' 'Remember.' 'Wait! Rest here. You are needed!'
